CREATIVE ARTS — TERMLY EXAM #8 (TERM 2)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. The middle stripe of the Kenyan flag is (1 mark)
   A. blue
   B. red
   C. black
   D. green

2. The bottom stripe of the Kenyan flag is (1 mark)
   A. green
   B. red
   C. white
   D. black

3. Compared with the medium start, the elongated start has the back knee (1 mark)
   A. in the air
   B. on the line
   C. further back
   D. further forward

4. Why is the national flag flown at national athletics events? (1 mark)
   A. To decorate only
   B. To hide the track
   C. To block the wind
   D. It shows which country the athletes represent and builds pride

5. Which health benefit comes from gymnastics? (1 mark)
   A. Weaker bones
   B. Better flexibility
   C. Less energy
   D. Slower breathing always

6. How long should you hold a crab balance in this lesson? (1 mark)
   A. Three to five counts
   B. One hour
   C. Ten minutes
   D. Half a second

7. Which should you remove before gymnastics? (1 mark)
   A. Your clothes
   B. Your smile
   C. Watches and bracelets
   D. Your hair

8. In a partner check for the crab balance, how many touching points does the table have? (1 mark)
   A. Two
   B. Eight
   C. Six
   D. Four

9. The East African Community is (1 mark)
   A. a river
   B. a group of countries in East Africa that work together
   C. a school
   D. a type of drum

10. A folk song is (1 mark)
   A. a traditional song belonging to a community
   B. a computer song
   C. a song without a message
   D. a song only for cities

11. Why should you sing folk songs from other communities with respect? (1 mark)
   A. They are funny
   B. They are part of our shared culture
   C. They must be changed
   D. They are unimportant

12. A topical song is (1 mark)
   A. always sad
   B. about the moon only
   C. about a topic that matters at a certain time
   D. without a tune

13. Photos on a digital device are kept in its (1 mark)
   A. strap
   B. lens
   C. memory
   D. flash

14. The centre of interest is (1 mark)
   A. the main thing you want people to notice
   B. the middle of the room
   C. the camera button
   D. the edge of the photo

15. Early morning and late afternoon light is (1 mark)
   A. too dark always
   B. soft and gentle
   C. absent
   D. harsh

16. After taking photos, choosing the best ones is called (1 mark)
   A. selecting
   B. smudging
   C. hiding
   D. painting

17. A descant recorder is made of (1 mark)
   A. metal foil only
   B. paper only
   C. glass
   D. plastic or wood

18. How many lines are on a staff? (1 mark)
   A. Three
   B. Five
   C. Ten
   D. Four

19. The descant recorder is played by (1 mark)
   A. striking it
   B. blowing air into it
   C. shaking it
   D. plucking strings

20. Which note is played with the thumb and holes 1, 2 and 3 covered? (1 mark)
   A. F
   B. A
   C. G
   D. B

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Explain why covering more holes makes a lower note. (3 marks)

22. Describe how to play the note G on the descant recorder and explain how to get a good tone. (5 marks)

23. Explain what a relay race is and how it teaches teamwork. (4 marks)

24. Why should you never point a camera directly at the sun? (3 marks)

25. Give three warm-up activities before sprinting. (3 marks)

26. Describe how to learn the East African Community anthem for performance. (4 marks)

27. Why does a recorder squeak when you blow too hard? (2 marks)

28. Give four hygiene measures for using a recorder. (4 marks)

29. What is a balance in gymnastics? (2 marks)
pages.answers:
CREATIVE ARTS — TERMLY EXAM #8 (TERM 2) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — red
   Red is the middle stripe.

2. A — green
   Green is at the bottom.

3. C — further back
   Elongated means longer, so the feet are further apart.

4. D — It shows which country the athletes represent and builds pride
   The flag is a symbol of the country.

5. B — Better flexibility
   Stretching and rolling help joints and muscles bend freely.

6. A — Three to five counts
   Hold the balance for three to five slow counts.

7. C — Watches and bracelets
   Jewellery can hurt you or others.

8. D — Four
   The table has four legs, two hands and two feet.

9. B — a group of countries in East Africa that work together
   The community brings countries together to cooperate.

10. A — a traditional song belonging to a community
   Folk songs are passed on by singing.

11. B — They are part of our shared culture
   Respect helps unity and cultural appreciation.

12. C — about a topic that matters at a certain time
   Topical songs give messages about topics such as health, safety or the environment.

13. C — memory
   Digital photos are stored in memory.

14. A — the main thing you want people to notice
   It draws the eye first.

15. B — soft and gentle
   These times give soft light.

16. A — selecting
   Selecting means choosing the best.

17. D — plastic or wood
   Recorders are commonly made of plastic or wood.

18. B — Five
   The staff has five lines.

19. B — blowing air into it
   A recorder is a wind instrument that you blow.

20. C — G
   G adds the third hole.

SECTION B
----
21. (3 marks)
   Answer: The column of air inside becomes longer, and a longer air column vibrates more slowly, giving a lower note.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for longer air column, 2 marks for lower note.

22. (5 marks)
   Answer: Hold the recorder with the left hand at the top and the right at the bottom. Cover the thumb hole and holes 1, 2 and 3 with the pads of the left fingers. Put the mouthpiece between the lips and blow gently and steadily with a soft too.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for holding, thumb hole, three holes, mouthpiece and gentle breath.

23. (4 marks)
   Answer: A relay is a race in which each runner in a team runs a short distance and passes a baton to the next runner. The team wins by working together and passing smoothly.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for team running, 1 mark for the baton, 2 marks for teamwork explanation.

24. (3 marks)
   Answer: It can hurt your eyes and the strong light will spoil the picture.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for eyes, 1 mark for picture, 1 mark for explanation.

25. (3 marks)
   Answer: Jogging, arm circles, leg swings, gentle stretching, short easy strides. Any three.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each activity.

26. (4 marks)
   Answer: Listen to it several times, read and discuss the words, clap the rhythm, sing line by line and then sing the whole song together in unison while standing straight and respectful.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

27. (2 marks)
   Answer: The air is blown too strongly, so the note jumps to a very high shrill sound. Blow more gently.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

28. (4 marks)
   Answer: Wash hands before playing; do not share it without cleaning; do not eat while playing; wipe the mouthpiece; clean it properly. Any four.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

29. (2 marks)
   Answer: A position held still for a few seconds under control.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for still position, 1 mark for control or holding.
